Wintun redistributable
======================

The Nyxveil Windows service loads wintun.dll (WireGuard Wintun) at runtime to
create the Nyxveil TUN adapter. Ship the official Wintun DLL next to
Nyxveil.Service.exe.

Upstream: https://www.wintun.net/
License: see the Wintun distribution LICENSE / COPYING files from the
official release you package.

Frozen Core does not embed Wintun; the client injects OpenFunc into
core/platform/windows.Factory (ErrWintunNotLinked until the DLL binds).
